entries.adapted_criterion: Client opens a shared-invoice link and completes the payment form -> the payment is processed by the simulated fee-split processor (card or eCheck, synthetic tokens only) and recorded against the invoice with the correct gross/fee posting split. LawPay is replaced by the deterministic SimProcessor behind the FeeSplitProcessor interface; the portal Pay button is replaced by the shared-link pay page (portal is a deferred module); real processing is post-v1 and Approval-required.

User clicks Share on an invoice and selects a recipient contact (need not be the matter's primary contact) -> the contact receives an email with a link to view and download the invoice PDF. Email is the only channel in v1 (SMS deferred with prejudice, program precedent); print is satisfied by the PDF download; the portal path belongs to the deferred client-portal module.

User selects multiple invoices and shares them by email in a chosen mode -> either all invoices go to one contact as a zip, or each invoice goes to its own contact as an individual link, per the chosen mode. Email-only (SMS adapted out, program precedent); both attested modes are built.

User activates a Payment Plan on an invoice with frequency, installment amount, and start date -> installment reminders follow the attested cadence (7 days before, due day, 7 after), and with auto-charge enabled the simulated processor debits the synthetic payment method each time an installment falls due, posting per the fee-split recipe. Auto-charge rides SimProcessor (LawPay adapted out); config surface bounded to attested fields (red-pen r4).
